title: Aubade One — the lamp that wakes you with daylight
description: A bedside lamp that brings the sunrise into the room thirty minutes before your alarm, so you wake the way the morning intended. Shipping in March.

sections.title: Wake up to a sunrise, every morning.
sections.lede: Aubade One fills the room with daylight for thirty minutes before your alarm, so the morning arrives before the noise does.

media.alt: Aubade One on a bedside table, glowing a low amber in a dark room

sections.title: An alarm tells you it is morning. Light lets your body find out for itself.

steps.title: Dawn, at 6:30
steps.body: A deep red glow, too faint to read by, starts thirty minutes before your alarm.

media.alt: The lamp's first glow, a dim red arc on the wall

steps.title: Sunrise, at 6:45
steps.body: The light warms through amber to gold as the room brightens around you.

media.alt: The room half lit in warm gold light

steps.title: Daylight, at 7:00
steps.body: Full, cool daylight. If you are still asleep, a soft chime of birdsong joins it.

media.alt: The room in full daylight, the lamp a bright white disc
